statement: AMD's announced gigawatt-scale accelerator commitments are concentrated in a handful of buyers: OpenAI at 6 gigawatts, Meta at 6 gigawatts, Anthropic at up to 2 gigawatts, plus a July 20, 2026 Microsoft expansion.
why: A small set of named customers accounts for essentially all of AMD's disclosed forward accelerator capacity, so the demand line depends on those buyers continuing to fund and take delivery.

impact.mechanism: Concentration of forward commitments in a few buyers supports near-term volume but makes the demand track sensitive to any single customer deferring or cancelling.

evidence.excerpt: AMD-OpenAI partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs

confidence.basis: The comparison figures come from a context note in the document that is drawn from AMD's prior releases seen on the IR index, not from this release body.
